description.value: Your entrails can be pulled from your insides and used as a rope without damaging your body. You can pull out up to 10 feet of your entrails as a single Interact action. You can do this multiple times, up to 50 feet worth of entrails, but one end must remain attached to you. As a single Interact action, you can have your entrails release anything currently attached to them and retract back into your body. If your entrails are destroyed while acting as a rope, you take @Damage[2d6[slashing]] damage and can't pull more out for 24 hours.
